description: Use this to change an expense. Send only the fields that change; expectedRevision is the lockVersion from get_transaction, and a stale one means someone else edited it, so read it again first. A new amountCents re-divides an equal split; for any other split type, send splits with the new amounts too.

SplitInput.description:
`amountCents` is each participant's share. With `splitType: equal`
it may be omitted from every split, and the server divides the
amount evenly (leftover cents go to the first participants). A split
of zero leaves that participant out; no zero split is stored.

amountCents.description: This member's share in minor units of the expense's currency.

participantToken.description: A member who shares the expense, by token from `showGroup`.

SplitType.description:
How a transaction's amount is divided across participants.
  • `equal` — equal shares across all listed participants.
  • `percentage` — percentage shares (sum to 100, server normalizes
    rounding cents).
  • `shares` — weighted shares (e.g. 1, 2, 1 → 25/50/25 split).
  • `amount` — exact per-participant amounts supplied by the client.

Token.description:
Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the
look-alikes `0`, `O`, `I` and `l`). A token never changes. The server
generates one when a create sends none; a client may choose its own for a
transaction, participant, category or recurring expense, so a write queued
offline already knows the token it will have.

amountCents.description: The total in minor units of `currency` (¥1,000 is 1000, $12.50 is 1250).

balanceCurrency.description:
Currency bucket used for balances. Omit to keep the current value, unless
the edit changes the amount or currency: then it moves to the group currency.
Only the group currency or the transaction's own `currency` is kept; any
other value (such as the group's previous currency) means the group currency.
Changing the group currency re-expresses balances without changing any
transaction's `lockVersion`.

categoryToken.description: Omit to keep the category; `null` clears it.

currency.description:
Omit to keep it. One other than the group's is converted into the group
currency at the rate on `date`.

date.description: The day it was paid, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Omit to keep it.

description.description: What the expense was for, as the group will see it.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

paidByParticipantToken.description: The member who paid, by token from `showGroup`. Omit to keep it.

splitType.description:
How the total is divided. `equal` divides it for you; for any other type
each split carries its own `amountCents`.

splits.description:
Who shares the expense, replacing every split. Omit to keep them: a new
total re-divides an `equal` split, any other type needs its splits resent.
For `equal`, list the members and omit `amountCents`: the server divides
the total, odd cents to the first members in the group's order. For
`amount`, `percentage` and `shares`, give each member's `amountCents`; they
must add up to the total (exactly for `amount`, otherwise within 1 per member).

timeOfDay.description: Time of day, `HH:MM` (24-hour). Omit to keep it.

transactionToken.description: The expense or payment's token, from `listTransactions` or `listSearchResults`.

name: update_expense
title: Edit an expense
